description: Update apps only once their manifest has aged
post_install: # Copied into the shims directory rather than shimmed. scoop's generated .ps1
# shim carries a '$path = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ...' line, and command_path
# evaluates that line from lib\commands.ps1, where $PSScriptRoot is scoop's lib
# directory - so a 'bin' entry would resolve to a path that does not exist.
# A raw scoop-*.ps1 has no $path line and command_path runs the file itself.
post_uninstall: # Nothing is removed on update. post_install overwrites both copies in place,
# and no other scoop machinery touches them - rm_shims only removes shims scoop
# itself created from a 'bin' entry, and there is none. So an update that aborts
# on a failed download leaves the previous version installed and still working,
# rather than a shims directory with no command in it.
# The command and its state must survive an update and not survive an uninstall,
# and no hook argument distinguishes the two. $appDir is a local of
# scoop-uninstall.ps1 and exists nowhere in the update path, so its presence
# marks a real uninstall. Should scoop ever rename it, both merely outlive the
# app - neither is ever deleted mid-update.
